title.zh: 谷歌向付费用户开放Gemini 4 Argon
title.en: Google opens Gemini 4 Argon to paid users

summary.zh: 谷歌向付费用户开放Gemini 4 Argon，提供API访问及机器人变体。
summary.en: Google opened Gemini 4 Argon to paid users with API access and a robotics variant.

title.zh: 迪士尼出价2000万美元竞购Character.AI资产
title.en: Disney bids $20 million for Character.AI assets

summary.zh: Character.AI破产后，迪士尼出价2000万美元竞购其资产；美国监管机构开始调查银行使用AI智能体的情况。
summary.en: Disney bid $20 million for bankrupt Character.AI's assets, and US regulators began probing banks' use of AI agents.

title.zh: 拦截胡塞导弹碎片坠落利雅得致4伤
title.en: Houthi missile debris injures four in Riyadh

summary.zh: 被拦截的胡塞导弹碎片落入利雅得，致4人受伤、15栋房屋受损；达兰一座沙特阿美办公楼发生小火。
summary.en: Debris from intercepted Houthi missiles injured four and damaged 15 homes in Riyadh; a small fire hit an Aramco building in Dhahran.

title.zh: 美军中央司令部驳斥伊朗控制霍尔木兹海峡说法
title.en: CENTCOM rejects Iran's Hormuz control claim

summary.zh: 美军中央司令部否认伊朗关于控制霍尔木兹海峡的说法；也门领导层誓言继续对胡塞行动。
summary.en: CENTCOM rejected Iran's claim of control over the Strait of Hormuz, as Yemen's leadership vowed to continue operations against the Houthis.

title.zh: 核心通胀超预期 美股创7月以来最差单日表现
title.en: Stocks have worst day since July on hot inflation

summary.zh: 10月14日核心通胀数据超预期，标普500跌1.1%，纳指跌1.9%，加息预期升温。
summary.en: Core inflation beat estimates on Oct. 14; the S&P 500 fell 1.1% and the Nasdaq 1.9% as rate-hike bets grew.

body.zh:
据美联社报道，10月14日公布的核心通胀数据高于预期，美股录得7月以来最差单日表现：标普500指数下跌1.1%至7718.94点，纳指下跌1.9%，罗素2000指数下跌1.9%。

《华尔街日报》称，通胀数据强化了加息预期，同时AI相关股票遭抛售。
body.en:
Per [AP](https://apnews.com/article/stock-markets-earnings-bonds-artificial-intelligence-704d3190f0fba2908df07c85f26346ec), hotter-than-expected core inflation sent stocks to their worst day since July: the S&P 500 fell 1.1% to 7,718.94 and the Nasdaq 1.9%.

The [WSJ](https://www.wsj.com/finance/stocks/u-s-stocks-fall-on-hot-inflation-report-ai-sell-off-6c98113d) said the data bolstered the case for a rate increase amid an AI sell-off.

title.zh: 海关总署：前三季度货物贸易进出口39.94万亿元 同比增长18.8%
title.en: China's Q1-Q3 goods trade up 18.8% to 39.94 trillion yuan

summary.zh: 海关总署披露，前三季度出口23.2万亿元、增长16.4%，进口16.74万亿元、增长22.3%。
summary.en: Customs said exports rose 16.4% to 23.2 trillion yuan and imports 22.3% to 16.74 trillion yuan in the first three quarters.

body.zh:
国务院新闻办公室10月14日举行新闻发布会，海关总署副署长王军介绍，前三季度我国货物贸易进出口总值39.94万亿元，同比增长18.8%。

其中出口23.2万亿元，增长16.4%；进口16.74万亿元，增长22.3%。（据[中新网](https://www.chinanews.com.cn/cj/2026/10-14/10714235.shtml)、[央视网](https://news.cctv.cn/2026/10/14/ARTIUWyrzbshAYGGLxXAgvpV261014.shtml)）
